turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Please send your order number, the email address you used to place the order, and your full new delivery address so I can check whether it can be updated.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.
Order SC-4040 has already shipped, so I couldn’t update the delivery address. I’ve handed this over to a colleague who will take over and check what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer george.miller.v2@example.com moved today and requests delivery to Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara. Policy check returned already_shipped; no change filed. Please review available options.
